Tableau Viz Extensions

2 extensions · Tableau 2024.2+ (Desktop, Server, Cloud)

Smart Table v1.4.0

Fast flat table for large data (virtual scrolling): sort and filter any column, search, conditional colors, totals, and row selection that drives dashboard actions.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Smooth Trend v1.6.0

Smooth line trend with a KPI header (latest, MTD, QTD, YTD or your own calculation), growth/degrowth coloring and smart tooltips.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

How to use

  1. Download the .trex file of the extension.
  2. In a worksheet, open the mark-type dropdown on the Marks card → Viz Extensions → Add Extension → Access Local Viz Extensions and pick the file.
  3. Tableau Server / Cloud: an admin adds https://munshi4533.github.io to the allowed extensions list.
